why: Writes the overrides into the shared QUALITY_PRESETS entry instead of a fresh object. One session's ?antialias=off would then reach every later session on the page built on the same preset, with no override in its URL.
killedBy: applyRenderOverrides (issue #735) changes exactly the field an override names -- population: 4 overrides x 3 presets
